A '''shield gauntlet''' was a small personal shield worn on the off-hand which could be used to absorb and even deflect energy weapons and shots. The gauntlet accomplished this by projecting a small energy shield, similar in function to that of a [[Gungan personal energy shield/Legends|Gungan personal energy shield]]. The shield's diameter was less than a meter and typically took on the appearance of a convex energy disc which was usually either tinted blue or transparent.

With the proper training, shield gauntlets could be used to deflect blaster fire. It was also possible to redirect the deflected bolts to strike other targets.

==History of Use==

[[File:Shieldgauntlet-RECG.jpg|thumb|left|125px|A [[Kilian Rangers/Legends|Kilian Ranger]] deflects incoming fire with a shield gauntlet.]]Shield gauntlets were used by the [[Kilian Rangers/Legends|Kilian Rangers]], both for defensive purposes and to remind themselves and others of the other half of their oaths: to defend themselves and their families.

Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], during the [[Battle of Mandalore/Legends|battle of]] [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], renegade [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] members, led by [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan Kryze]] and mostly consisting of members of the [[Nite Owls/Legends|Nite Owls]], used shield gauntlets to protect themselves from [[Mandalorian super commando/Legends|Mandalorian super commandos]]. During a firefight between the two groups, several members of Death Watch activated the gauntlets in order to protect against the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster fire]] of the commandos.
